comments.author: Visitor
comments.body:
Hn. Further research seems to suggest that Bodyguard is mandatory, after all:

gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Job/Soldier

This job features a notice in red text, "Bouncer limited". Bouncer likely means Bodyguard, and limited seems to indicate "that job is required for the quest". Several other red-text notices refer to job class changing restrictions, such as Filibuster's requirements... so it is as reasonable a theory as any.

I suspect that recent reports mean you don't actually need the skill requirements to make this quest appear; only to be in Bodyguard job.
